tests: Shift+F10 opens the editor's menu at the top-left corner of the IDE window, not at the caret
steps:
1. Open any project and a module, and put the caret on a line in the middle of the code editor.
2. Press Shift+F10. The editor's context menu (Go To Definition, Last Position, ...) opens at the top-left corner of the IDE window, over the menu bar, not at the caret.
Control: a right-click in the code opens the same menu at the pointer.
